title: Liquid hydrogen made by hand at Node Gamma from the trader's own stored hydrogen gas, docked, no jump
note: 2026-11-22 19:46 UTC (Mercury): orders ENT-065, block MERCURY (every trader operating at the least fuel per XP) and P1 (train at the least fuel per XP), rule F8 (docked zero-fuel crafting before jump loops) and F23 (every ship crafts its own stores). Traders store 313 (2 traders) of hydrogen gas here (table holdings, 2026-11-22 19:44 UTC); its bids at home are none or thin (sellgen.py scan 19:42 UTC) and none of it is reserved (pull.py levels 19:37 UTC: liquid_hydrogen is no good of the reserve, so the pull rule does not close this route). 8 hydrogen gas (base 8) into 3 liquid hydrogen (best bid 112 x 30 at Sirius; an input of craft_fuel_cell, Logistics' fuel cells for the outpost bunker) (by hand, 0 cr). A trader docked here trains Crafting with no jump and no fuel, in place of the jump loop (train-jumps-trader, -540 cr a ship-hour in 12 hours; docked crafts measured 1,400 to 2,000 XP a ship-hour, fleet view=xp 19:27 UTC). The craft list asks the recipe in halving sizes (128 down to 1, as craft-nitrogen-own-*): a size the stores cannot fill makes nothing and the next is asked. The list then asks extract_xenon (6 xenon gas into 3 purified xenon) in the same sizes, for the xenon some of these traders store here. Nothing is bought or sold; the output stays in the pilot's storage. Standing work; closes by itself under 80 hydrogen gas stored here. A test: three results decide (F37); max_ships 2, the traders that hold the gas here.
